metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Geometric Display Type

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast black and white facial portrait featuring voluminous curly hair framing the face, overlaid with bold, geometric display lettering that incorporates internal red triangular accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry of the face vs. organic texture of the hair
High-contrast grayscale skin tones vs. vibrant red typographic accents
Geometric rigidity of the title vs. soft curves of the facial features
Top-aligned text anchoring the vertical composition
coreInvariants: Geometric sans-serif display type with hollow/inline features
Red as the sole chromatic accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, extreme close-up, filling approximately 85% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves upward to the bold display text, then follows the hair texture down to the mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the dark, dense curls act as a textured background frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white grayscale for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair and shadows provide depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used exclusively for geometric fills within the lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face (bright highlights, deep shadows) with zero saturation except for the flat, high-saturation red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Internal triangular red fills at the base or corners of characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: A-frame without crossbar, replaced by a red triangle
L with a red square/triangle at the vertex
S with a segmented inline path

treatment.fill: white outline with red geometric inserts

typesetting.alignment: left-aligned under first letter of title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric display for impact paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for secondary info.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a woman with voluminous, dark curly hair framing her face. The lighting should be soft on the skin but create deep shadows in the hair. The expression should be neutral with slightly parted lips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric custom lettering across the top. The letters should be white outlines with vibrant red triangles placed inside the corners or bases of the characters. Add a smaller, solid white sans-serif subtitle justified to the left below the main text.

verificationChecks: Are the red accents limited to the interior of the letters?
Is the hair texture detailed and high-contrast?
Is the main text centered and geometric?

adjustableVariables: Placement of red geometric accents within letters
mustRedesign: Specific letter shapes that mimic trademarked logos
Exact facial identity of the original subject

mustAchieve: Clean, vector-like precision in the typography
Seamless integration of text over hair texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure red (#FF0000) saturation in accents.
Ensure no color bleeding from red into the monochrome portrait.
Verify the 'A' characters are rendered as triangles.
Confirm the composition is vertically oriented and tight.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + Geometric Inline Type + Primary Color Geometric Accents
